title: [finding] `check:cross-package-test-inputs` reds as a function of LOCAL build state — a gitignored `packages/spec/dist` makes it name an untouched path, and CI can never see it
body:
Reported by the `domain:services` dev that delivered **#18424** (PR #18562) as an out-of-scope finding, and filed here by the seat — dev agents report findings with dedupe words; they ⛔ do not file.

## The defect

`pnpm check:cross-package-test-inputs` **reds as a function of local build state**, not of the diff under test. It reports `packages/cli/test/init-created-files-summary.e2e.test.ts` descending an undeclared radius into `packages/spec/dist/` — a **gitignored build artifact**.

## Reproduction

1. Build any closure that produces `packages/spec/dist`.
2. Run `pnpm check:cross-package-test-inputs`.
3. It reds, naming a path unrelated to whatever you changed.

## Why it is a defect and not a true finding — two-leg control

The dev isolated the variable with the **same diff present in both legs**:

| leg | result |
|---|---|
| `packages/spec/dist` on disk | **exit 1** |
| that gitignored directory moved aside | **exit 0** — *"29 packages read outside themselves, all declared"* |

The directory was verified restored afterwards (**216 files before == 216 after**). ⇒ the only variable is the build artifact.

## Why nobody sees it in CI, which is what makes it expensive

`lint.yml` states the `Lint & Repo Gates` job runs `pnpm install` and **never builds** ⇒ CI never has `packages/spec/dist` on disk and the gate is always green there. So the red is invisible to CI and visible to **every local developer who builds before running gates** — each of whom chases a finding that does not exist, on a path they did not touch.

## Dedupe words

`check:cross-package-test-inputs` · `packages/spec/dist build state` · `init-created-files-summary undeclared radius` · `gate false positive build artifact` · `cross-package test inputs gitignored dist`

Related: #18424 / PR #18562 (where it was measured) · `lint.yml` `Lint & Repo Gates`

⛔ `type`, `priority` **and `domain:*`** are the triage seat's. ⚠️ **This card is filed with no `domain:*` deliberately**: the landing point is a gate under `scripts/`, and the domain table routes `scripts/` (gate class) to `domain:spec` by the anchoring exception *while* sending gates whose SUBJECT is the governed surface to `domain:skills`. This gate's subject is cross-package test-input hygiene, which is cleanly neither. Per 「落点不明留分诊首触,⛔ 不猜」 the execution seat is ⛔ not guessing the route.
